spec.description: Provider operations for Nais Postgres (CNPG): one, several or all tenant datasources, with separate repeated sections and branch-level CPU/memory/PVC resources with tenant totals. panels.description: Current observations, including replicas and inactive branches. Major version requires a positive CNPG version from every discovered pod with agreement across pods; otherwise Unknown. It is not the desired version from the parent Postgres resource. CPU is requested cores and observed CPU rate; memory is requested bytes and working set; PVC is requested size, actual filesystem capacity and bytes used. Each pgdata claim is counted once per branch. Resource footers sum this tenant and the selected filters, not all tenants. Missing/partial measurements make the affected branch cell and resource total Unknown, never zero or a silently partial footprint. Missing pod discovery remains outside this inventory. Excludes poolers, operators, backup objects, network and logging. Exactly one observed primary is expected; streaming replicas are actual connections, not desired HA count. Colour thresholds are triage hints, not alert policies.
